evidence_summary: Primary collagen-I studies support selected alpha1beta1/alpha2beta1 collagen receptors and distinguish collagen-subtype and conformation-specific recognition, but no exact primary experiment was verified for the remaining COL1A2-to-listed-receptor candidates.
limitations: Retain assembled collagen-I, triple-helical conformation and integrin-family context; do not transfer it to CD44, CD93, alpha2beta, alpha3beta1, alpha9beta1 or beta3 candidates without pair-specific chain/domain evidence.
